newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: INDEPENDENT ALLEGES ZIMBABWE MAYORAL POLL RIGGED.
newsitem.headline: INDEPENDENT ALLEGES ZIMBABWE MAYORAL POLL RIGGED.

text.p: A leading Zimbabwean democracy campaigner charged on Monday he lost a weekend race for Harare's mayoral election through rigging.
His rival and polling officials were unavailable to comment.

University of Zimbabwe lecturer law lecturer Kempton Makamure said he would ask the courts to nullify the poll in which Solomon Tawengwa of President Robert Mugabe's ruling ZANU-PF party won with 14,446 votes to his 4,182 votes.
Makamure alleged ballot boxes were opened in his absence before counting and may have been stuffed with false votes.
"I have no alternative except to apply to the courts to nullify this electoral facade and order a fresh election conducted on normal democratic lines," he said.
Many political analysts had predicted a close race between Tawengwa, a prominent Harare businessman, and Makamure, an outspoken government critic.
